author: Life of Boris
description:
up next: how to cook with a door.
this is Chłodnik Litewski in Poland or simply "cold borscht".
this is recipe for hot weather.
cold pink soup with beets.
serving suggestion: a lot.
refrigerate, eat within three days.
(you can buy boiled potatoes, beets and eggs if you're lazy)
enjoy with side of roast potato or grilled meat
serves 6 people
also known as aukstā zupa in Latvia and šaltibarščiai in Lithuania.

ingredients:
1L buttermilk
400g boiled beets
4 hardboiled eggs (3 for soup, 1 for decoration)
1 boiled potato
2tbsp white vinegar
1tbsp sugar for beets
1tsp salt for beets
more salt for seasoning buttermilk
some cucumber
green onion
dill
some bologna sausage (aka doctor's sausage)
